Apple (AAPL) Holder Columbus Circle Investors Cut Its Holding; Ativo Capital Management Trimmed Alibaba Group Holding LTD Sp A (BABA) Stake by $779,946 as Share Value Rose
June 19, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Ativo Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Ltd Sp A (BABA) by 6.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ativo Capital Management Llc sold 4,262 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 64,456 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.83 million, down from 68,718 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ativo Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Holding Ltd Sp A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $535.92B market cap company. The stock increased 0.27% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $208.57. About 14.65 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 61.13% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 48.56% the S&P500.
